name: Lean.Grind.IntInterval.casesOn
typeText:
{motive : Lean.Grind.IntInterval → Sort u} →
  (t : Lean.Grind.IntInterval) →
    ((lo hi : Int) → motive (Lean.Grind.IntInterval.co lo hi)) →
      ((lo : Int) → motive (Lean.Grind.IntInterval.ci lo)) →
        ((hi : Int) → motive (Lean.Grind.IntInterval.io hi)) → motive Lean.Grind.IntInterval.ii → motive t

source.code:
/-- An interval in the integers (either finite, half-infinite, or infinite). -/
inductive IntInterval : Type where
  | /-- The finite interval `[lo, hi)`. -/
    co (lo hi : Int)
  | /-- The half-infinite interval `[lo, ∞)`. -/
    ci (lo : Int)
  | /-- The half-infinite interval `(-∞, hi)`. -/
    io (hi : Int)
  | /-- The infinite interval `(-∞, ∞)`. -/
    ii
  deriving BEq, ReflBEq, LawfulBEq, DecidableEq, Inhabited
